Sourav Ganguly Biopic 'Dada' First Look Released, Set for 2027

The first look of the upcoming biopic 'Dada', based on the life of former Indian cricket captain Sourav Ganguly, has been released. Actor Rajkummar Rao portrays Ganguly in the film, directed by Vikramaditya Motwane. The movie is scheduled to hit theatres on May 14, 2027. The release of the first look coincided with Ganguly's 54th birthday.
